int form_dial (  void *  ns,
alert_type  at,
alert_buttons  ab,
const char *  msg,
const char *  btxt
) 
 

handle a dialog.

Returns:
index of selected button if ab==ALERT_BUTTONS_CUSTOM, or one of { NOIR_SUCC, NOIR_FAIL } otherwise.
Parameters:
ns - the session that caused this dialog, or NULL
at - what symbol to show (ALERT_ERROR/ALERT_QUESTION)
ab - what buttons to show (ALERT_BUTTONS_OK,ALERT_BUTTONS_YES_NO,ALERT_BUTTONS_CUSTOM)
msg - the message to display
btxt - the labels for the buttons if ab==ALERT_BUTTONS_CUSTOM, separated by pipe-characters "|"

void form_file_edit (  const char *  op,
char **  t
) 
 

user tries to copy or move a file on top of itself.

ask them for a better target name. this function will block until the user decides; if after the call the src and tgt names are still the same, the calling function should abort, otherwise, it should copy/move/rename.

Parameters:
op - the operation in question, single word ("copy" or "move"), or full description
t - where the pointer to the target name is stored (may change)
